setlist.title: Beat It On Down The Line

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Playing In The Band** (2 reviews): Features a big long jam lasting almost half an hour [16][17]
- **The Other One** (2 reviews): Spans about twenty minutes of intense space after Jerry's noodling, then returns into a strong Eyes of the World; Reviewer hears this Other One as dark and unusual, leading into an Eyes that makes all the right moves [8][11]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Band returns from the space to deliver an incredible Eyes; Sunshine and Playin' also singled out [8]

## Setlist highlights

- **Phil And Billy**: mythic rare: 2 archived performances [18]

## The recordings

- **gd73-05-13.sbd.powell-ladner.24997.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 33 songs; 252 min; rated 4.28/5 by 18 [1]. Said about its sound: Louder than the alternate source but noticeably hissier; Hissier but fuller-sounding than the other copy, which seems noise reduced; reviewer finds this more listenable; Quality is not the greatest, but the He's Gone through Sugar Magnolia segment is worth getting [6][7][8][11][16]
- **gd1973-05-13.sbd.smith-lee.GEMS.97558.flac16**: soundboard; 32 songs; 260 min; rated 3.5/5 by 2 [2]. Said about its sound: The mix is erratic at times [2]
- **gd73-05-13.sbd.minches.7270.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 33 songs; 260 min; rated 3/5 by 2 [3]. Said about its sound: First three discs sound noise reduced, muffled and flat; the other copy is hissy from cassette generation but more dynamic [9]
- **gd1973-05-13.sbd.partial.smith.miller.100239.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 5 songs; 68 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [4]. Said about its sound: Audio has issues; Garcia is high in the mix [17]
- **gd1973-05-13.set3.sbd.fix.smith.miller.100302.flac16**: soundboard; 5 songs; 69 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [5]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended, camping at the fairground; a three-set show included a short rain shower and a great rainbow [10]
- Casey Jones was the encore per dead.net, but this copy places it at the start of the second set [12]
- Reviewer hitchhiked from WIU, slept at the fairgrounds on Mother's Day; rain, then sunshine and a double rainbow as Here Comes Sunshine played [13]
- Casey Jones is listed as the encore after Sugar Magnolia [1]
- Counted among many gems from February to June 1973, all leading up to 6/22/73 at the PNE Coliseum [11]
- Reviewer saw the band at least six times in the 70s and calls this their best [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd73-05-13.sbd.powell-ladner.24997.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Chain is MSR to reel to unknown to cassette to DAT to WAV to SHN; fourth disc and second-set end come from another source [1]
- **gd1973-05-13.sbd.smith-lee.GEMS.97558.flac16**: transferred by Matt Smith and Jamie Waddell; source: Lineage-MR>??>TDK C90 cassettes(3)>R [2]. Also: Matt Smith did the transfer work; Pat Lee supplied the tapes [2]
- **gd73-05-13.sbd.minches.7270.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [3]
- **gd1973-05-13.sbd.partial.smith.miller.100239.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller and Matt Smith; source: SBD -> Master Reel [4]
- **gd1973-05-13.set3.sbd.fix.smith.miller.100302.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller and Matt Smith; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat -> CD [5]. Also: Disc supplied by Matt Smith; pitch fixed and levels adjusted, with Joe B. Jones helping on pitch correction [5]

## Art and photos

- Poster by GRAMMY: [Grateful Dead box unreleased, sought-after shows for limited edition](https://www.goldminemag.com/artist-news/grateful-dead-box-unreleased-sought-after-shows-for-limited-edition/) [20]
- Fan art by Kevin Mason: [Grateful Dead Rock Des Moines: Iowa Time Machine May 13,](https://www.notesoniowa.com/post/grateful-dead-rock-des-moines-iowa-time-machine-may-13) [21]
